failures.root_cause: sw-cost-test.sh 'CONTEXT EFFICIENCY' dashboard tests fail because the cost dashboard prints 'No cost entries in the last 30 days' and exits early, never rendering the context-efficiency section from the seeded loop.context_efficiency events (test seeds only events, no cost entries).
failures.fix: Make the cost dashboard render the CONTEXT EFFICIENCY section even when there are no cost entries (or have the test seed a cost entry/use an events path the dashboard reads) so the avg budget utilization assertions pass.

failures.root_cause: Two suites failed: sw-e2e-integration-test hit a stale pipeline lock/state ('pipeline already in progress') left by the outer pipeline run, and sw-intent-analysis-test failed its schema check for required fields (version, goal, criteria).
failures.fix: Make the e2e integration test run with isolated state/lock dir (or skip when a pipeline is already running), and update the intent analysis schema or the analyze_intent output so they agree on the required fields.

failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test.sh failed with 1 of 78 tests failing (exit 1 after 38s); sw-e2e-integration-test also timed out at 301s, likely because it needs real Claude/GitHub access
failures.fix: Run scripts/sw-intent-analysis-test.sh directly to identify the failing assertion and fix it; separately skip or mock sw-e2e-integration-test in CI so it can't hit the 300s timeout

failures.root_cause: Three suites failed: sw-e2e-integration-test hit a stale pipeline lock/in-progress state ('A pipeline is already in progress'), sw-intent-analysis-test found the generated intent JSON missing required schema fields (version, goal, criteria), and sw-project-detect-test's cache-behavior check returned a different result from the cached detection. Most likely the e2e failure is environmental and not caused by the README change.
failures.fix: Make the e2e integration test use an isolated state dir or skip when a pipeline is already running; fix the intent-analysis output or schema to include version/goal/criteria; and make the project-detect cache comparison ignore the timestamp field and use the same cache dir.

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test, which needs real Claude and real GitHub, hung inside a nested build loop (it ran a full npm test, which re-enters the test suite) and hit the 300s suite timeout. The other 162 suites passed.
failures.fix: Skip sw-e2e-integration-test in CI and pipeline test runs unless real Claude and GitHub credentials are available, or make it set NO_GITHUB and use mock binaries. Also stop its loop from running the full npm test recursively, or raise its timeout.

failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test, which runs a real Claude session and real GitHub calls, hit the 300s suite timeout. The 124 PASS | 4 FAIL line is that suite's partial output; the other 162 suites passed.
failures.fix: Skip or mock sw-e2e-integration-test in CI (it needs live network access), or raise its timeout and make it fail fast when the Claude/GitHub calls hang.
